request.description: Export test cases as CSV. The CSV includes import-compatible fields such as reference, row-level section_id, multistep data with step test data/order, timestamps, and suite custom fields when exporting a specific suite.

Import test cases from CSV. Honors Idempotency-Key, supports import_mode create_only, skip_duplicates, update_existing, create_copy, and matches duplicates by id, reference, external_key, title + section, and title + suite.

body.raw:
{
  "test_suite_id": 1,
  "skip_duplicates": true,
  "duplicate_mode": "skip_duplicates",
  "import_mode": "skip_duplicates",
  "filename": "test-cases.csv",
  "dry_run": false,
  "import_job_id": "{{importJobId}}",
  "chunk_index": 0,
  "total_chunks": 1,
  "rows": [
    {
      "id": 123,
      "row_number": 2,
      "title": "Imported login happy path",
      "description": "Created from the CSV preview flow",
      "preconditions": "User exists and is active",
      "steps": "1. Open login page\n2. Enter valid credentials\n3. Submit",
      "expected_result": "User lands on the dashboard",
      "reference": "REQ-123",
      "external_key": "EXT-LOGIN-001",
      "priority": "medium",
      "test_type": "manual",
      "status": "active",
      "section_id": 1,
      "order_index": 1,
      "is_multistep": true,
      "multistep_data": "[{\"step_number\":1,\"action\":\"Open login page\",\"expected_result\":\"Login form is visible\",\"step_type\":\"manual\",\"data\":{\"email\":\"demo@testmona.com\"},\"order_index\":0}]",
      "created_at": "2026-05-16T09:00:00",
      "tags": "csv,import",
      "import_action": "skip_duplicates",
      "duplicate_hint": true,
      "custom_field_values": []
    }
  ]
}

request.description: Import mapped test cases. Honors Idempotency-Key, supports import_mode create_only, skip_duplicates, update_existing, create_copy, per-row import_action, chunk metadata, row_results, and duplicate matching by id/reference/external_key/title+section/title+suite.
